activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is configured but not enforced on this private personal-account repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: Move the repository to an eligible topology and verify a negative bypass test.

activeRisks.statement: Parallel Atlas lanes can drift if the four shared data contracts are changed implicitly.
activeRisks.closureGate: Bootstrap merge freezes CONTRACTS.md and QA rejects undeclared fields or semantic changes.

activeRisks.statement: Event and projection defects could lose or overstate learner evidence.
activeRisks.closureGate: Independent QA proves replay, interruption, export/import, invalid-event rejection and claim boundaries.

activeRisks.statement: Adaptive planning and gamification could make the visible product more complex or manipulative.
activeRisks.closureGate: Steve review and human validation prove a simple Today-session-summary flow and non-punitive rewards.

activeRisks.statement: Shared composition files can serialize parallel delivery or invite hidden repairs.
activeRisks.closureGate: Only INT owns shared composition paths and the candidate proves exact lane heads with no undeclared overlap.

activeExceptions.rule: main branch protection must technically require pull requests and mandatory checks
activeExceptions.reason: GitHub reports the configured ruleset as not enforced on the current private personal-account repository.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: repository plan or ownership topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator
activeExceptions.rollback: Remove the exception only after enforcement is reported and a negative bypass test passes.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Human merge of the bootstrap PR after review of the Atlas constitution, ADR-0003, shared contracts, disjoint lane ownership and this governor state. The bootstrap must not change product runtime code.
